_comment: OPTIONAL local override (git-ignored). Copy to gs-admin-explorer.config.json and fill in only the fields you need.
_privateInstancePatterns: Extra case-insensitive regexes for build/check-instance-data.mjs: org-specific strings (your real tenant slugs, your org name, your consumer workspace's KB folder names) that must never appear in this repo. They live only in this git-ignored config so the detection patterns themselves never enter git history. CI gets the same list from the repository secret PRIVATE_INSTANCE_PATTERNS (one regex per line) through the environment; a fork's pull request gets no secrets and runs the generic built-in patterns only. List each org slug BARE as well as any folder-name pattern (kb/<slug>-prod): masking learns the tokens of four or more characters inside each match, so a slug matched only joined to a suffix is not masked where it recurs bare, and an identifier shorter than four characters needs its own pattern.
